The '''Fodro system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Clacis sector/Legends|Clacis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fodro]].
